text:
MARROWGATE, 14 March 2024 (Meridian Brief) — Henrik Dalloway chairs the Marrowgate Water Board, following confirmation of his appointment at the board's annual general meeting on Thursday, people familiar with the matter said.

Seven of nine board members voted in favour of Dalloway. Priya Vennhalt, the board's Secretary, read out the confirmed appointment and recorded the vote during the session.

The outcome is set out in the Marrowgate Water Board Annual General Meeting minutes (Ref. MWB-AGM-2024-03), which have been published on the board's public records page.

Dalloway takes the chair immediately, according to those familiar with the proceedings. The board's remaining business at the meeting followed its standard annual agenda.

Meridian Brief will report further developments as they are confirmed.
